transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, um, thank you so much for seeing me. I hope I'm not taking time away from someone who needs it more. But, um... I guess I came in because I've been trying to, you know, clean up my image and my daily routine for some arts board stuff I'm involved in. And... well, I've just been feeling a little more tense and maybe a bit more down than I expected to? 

It's probably nothing huge, I'm still doing all the basic things I need to do! But I just keep dropping these little things that I normally really care about... like my fair planning notes or some of my design drafts. And then I just feel so guilty about falling behind, so I end up canceling plans with friends instead of just catching up on the work. 

Does that make sense? I just... I hope I'm explaining it right. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by being here.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that usually make you happy, like your art or spending time with friends?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so? I mean, I still really love my art, and my friends are wonderful. When I actually sit down to work on a piece or when we do hang out, I still have a really good time! 

It's not that I don't enjoy them anymore... it's just more that I get so caught up in feeling guilty about being behind that I kind of... avoid them? But the feeling of liking them is definitely still there. I hope that's okay to say—I know some people lose interest in everything when they come to a doctor for feeling down, but I definitely still care about my hobbies. Is it normal that I still enjoy things? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you find yourself worrying more than usual, even about things that you wouldn't have been concerned about before?

Um... no, I don't think so? I mean, besides the guilt about falling behind on my board stuff, I wouldn't say I'm worrying about new things, or... things that wouldn't normally bother me. 

I'm not suddenly stressed about everyday stuff, if that makes sense. It's really just that specific pressure I'm putting on myself to be better with my routine and my image. Everything else feels pretty normal, honestly! 

I'm sorry if that's not the answer you were looking for, or if I'm supposed to be worrying more. I hope it's okay that I don't have that happening... I just really want to make sure I'm giving you a clear picture of what's going on. Is that helpful at all?
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus or make decisions lately, even about small things?

Um... no, actually. I think my focus is still pretty good! When I need to sit down and concentrate on something, I can still do it just fine. And making decisions hasn't really been an issue for me either. I mean, maybe I'm a little indecisive sometimes about tiny things, like what to make for lunch, but nothing worse than usual, I promise! 

I hope it's alright that I don't have that happening... I know you're asking for a reason, and I really want to be as helpful as possible. Am I doing okay with answering your questions? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know.
